title: IELTS Academic Vol 7 - Reading Test 1 - Passage 3
passageHtml:
READING PASSAGE 3

Neanderthal Technology

A We think of our prehistoric ancestors as people of the ice and snow, living in caves... open-air sites with constructed shelter were the only option.

B In south-west France, the limestone caves of the Périgord region made ideal homes for the Neanderthal people... exceptionally benign habitat...

C In Central and Eastern Europe, open-air sites were mostly located near water... From Moldova, comes evidence of a large tent: a ring of mainly mammoth bones.

D In the Grotte du Lazaret, claims for skin tents have been advanced... wolf and fox foot bones indicate the use of animal pelts. Ancient fires are edged with small marine mollusc shells. The cave of Baume-Bonne contains cobbles laid down to take care of a puddle area.

E survival in the sub-arctic conditions is inconceivable without control of fire. Fire gave warmth, light, and defence against predatory animals. A charred piece of birch from Krapina is thought to be a twirl stick. Judging from shallow heat penetration, this fire was only of a short duration.
